exposure: Foley catheter with traction method for labor induction
Foley catheter with non-traction method for labor induction
cohort: 200 pregnant women with singleton cephalic pregnancies, gestational age 37-41 weeks, undergoing labor induction via Foley catheter.
finding: The traction method in Foley catheter-induced labor induction significantly shortened induction-to-expulsion and induction-to-delivery times and improved Bishop scores without compromising maternal or fetal safety.
mod_finding: The traction group showed a non-significant trend towards higher rates of vaginal deliveries and successful VBAC compared to the non-traction group.
